run_batch_ray_cast: run a pybullet simulation that casts 1024 rays in a circle around a loaded URDF model
create_ray_test_batch: create a batch ray test using p.rayTestBatch with lists of ray origins and targets
load_urdf_model: load a URDF robot model into a pybullet simulation at a specified position
visualize_rays_with_debug_lines: visualize ray cast hits and misses using p.addUserDebugLine with colored debug lines
profile_ray_cast_performance: profile ray cast performance using p.startStateLogging and p.stopStateLogging in DIRECT mode
